entrees.groupe: Use MCP-backed tools in ChatGPT web

entrees.usage:
1. Open the gear menu, then select **MCP servers**.
2. Select **Add server**.
3. Enter a name, choose **STDIO** or **Streamable HTTP**, and provide the server's command or URL.
4. Save the server, then select **Restart extension**.

entrees.description_source: Installed plugins can bundle MCP servers in their plugin manifest. Those servers are launched from the plugin, so user config doesn't set their transport command. User config can still control on/off state and tool policy under plugins.<plugin>.mcp_servers.<server>.
entrees.groupe: Use MCP-backed tools in ChatGPT web

en.texte: Installed plugins can bundle MCP servers in their plugin manifest. Those servers are launched from the plugin, so user config doesn't set their transport command. User config can still control on/off state and tool policy under plugins.<plugin>.mcp_servers.<server>.

fr.texte: Les plugins installés peuvent regrouper des serveurs MCP dans leur manifeste de plugin. Ces serveurs sont lancés depuis le plugin ; la configuration utilisateur ne définit donc pas leur commande de transport. La configuration utilisateur peut néanmoins contrôler l'état activé/désactivé et la politique d'outils sous plugins.<plugin>.mcp_servers.<server>.

entrees.usage:
Write a prompt for ChatGPT Work or Codex to rebuild this workflow as MCP tools. Identify which operations read information and which make changes.

Include the API operation, inputs, returned fields, and answer format. Mark anything you don't know. Leave out credentials, secrets, and hidden instructions.

Ask the builder to reuse the API and explain the connection setup.

entrees.description_source: - STDIO servers: Servers that run as a local process (started by a command). - Environment variables - Streamable HTTP servers: Servers that you access at an address. - Bearer token authentication - OAuth authentication, including Client ID Metadata Documents (CIMD) and Dynamic Client Registration (DCR) - ChatGPT session authentication for trusted first-party servers - Server instructions: Codex reads the MCP instructions field returned during initialization and uses it as server-wide guidance alongside the server's tools.

en.texte: - STDIO servers: Servers that run as a local process (started by a command). - Environment variables - Streamable HTTP servers: Servers that you access at an address. - Bearer token authentication - OAuth authentication, including Client ID Metadata Documents (CIMD) and Dynamic Client Registration (DCR) - ChatGPT session authentication for trusted first-party servers - Server instructions: Codex reads the MCP instructions field returned during initialization and uses it as server-wide guidance alongside the server's tools.

fr.texte: - Serveurs STDIO : serveurs exécutés comme processus local (lancés par une commande). - Variables d'environnement - Serveurs HTTP streamable : serveurs auxquels on accède à une adresse. - Authentification par jeton Bearer - Authentification OAuth, y compris Client ID Metadata Documents (CIMD) et Dynamic Client Registration (DCR) - Authentification de session ChatGPT pour les serveurs de première partie de confiance - Instructions de serveur : Codex lit le champ MCP instructions renvoyé lors de l'initialisation et l'utilise comme consigne globale au serveur, en complément des outils du serveur.
